MapWashtenaw
This interactive map viewer provides access to the latest parcel data available from Washtenaw County. The viewer also shows other layers of interest including aerial photos, topography, schools, and natural features.
Water Resources Commissioner's Office
Looking for a custom map? The Washtenaw County MapStore , hosted in the Water Resources Commissioner's Office, offers custom parcel maps (printed or PDF).
Water Resources Commissioner's Office's Maps : Download PDF county drain or environmental resource maps.
Elections
View a list of polling locations
Find my Elected Washtenaw County Officials

Parks
Washtenaw County Parks and Recreation Commission has PDF maps of the Border-to-Border Trail and their parks and preserves.
Equalization
Find the latest plat book and other parcel reports at Washtenaw County Equalization .
